newsitem.title: USA: RailTex Inc Dec carloadings up 13.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: RailTex Inc Dec carloadings up 13.6 pct.

text.p: RailTex Inc said its carloadings for December 1996 increased 13.6 percent to 29,428 from 25,907 in December 1995.
For the year, the company said, carloadings increased 13.0 percent to 359,669 from 318,187 in 1995.
The results include the 1996 acquisitions of the Indiana & Ohio, Connecticut Southern, Ontario L'Orignal and Pittsburgh Industrial railroads.
On a same-railroad basis, the company said, carloadings increased 2.1 percent to 26,109 in December 1996 from 25,584 in December 1995.
